finding: Ambush reveal gate: hidden members queue and reveal only when 3 are ready, or a tough threat is visible, or 3 visible threats are near, or at most one unseen threat (mon-lurk.cc 204-250). Maps to our max-3 attackers rule.

Leader-keyed band table: 179 leader entries, 133 band types, each with a size range, natural-leader flag and branch conditions (mon-place.cc 1859 onward). Lair branch uses a weighted pick of yak, death-yak and dream-sheep bands.
Gnoll camp serial vault: 13 layouts, 12 tagged patrolling, places 4-6 camps at depth 5-10 with 10 percent chance. Camps are small ASCII stamps with a leader and followers.
Guardian altar stamp: a unique item on an altar, a ring of statues, and a patrolling guard band. 61 guarded_unrand entries in dat/des; example in mini_monsters.des line 9057.
Walk density: no per-level monster count or 20-second figure found in the parts read. Escort: no escort template in dat/des, dat/mons or mon-*.cc.

Pit as theme filter: 40 pit/nest/other templates, each with a base family, required and banned traits (for example fire breath required, cold banned), a ban list, and a level-sorted list of 16 members (pit.txt; gen-room.c build_pit 2780-2850).

Friend and escort groups in Angband: 433 friends lines; group size scales as total times (depth minus monster level plus 5) over 10, with a probabilistic extra; no group at zero or below (mon-make.c 1283-1312).
Stamp density knob: vault legend gives per-cell monster 50 percent, object 25 percent, trap 6.25 percent (vault.txt line 43); pits give a per-square object chance (pit.txt header line 40).
Level profiles aim for 50 rooms (classic, params 11:50:200:2) or 50 with 500 unusual (lair, min level 20). Room rows carry rarity and a cutoff roll; 66 Interesting rooms with rating 0 (vault.txt).

Donor comment on place_friends says more than 4 levels out of depth gets no groups; the arithmetic gives 5 or more (depth minus level plus 5 at or below 0). Read the code, not the comment. Server half: none found in top-level listing.
